definitions.csr: Claim settlement ratio by NUMBER of claims, FY 2024-25 = claims paid during the year / (claims outstanding at the start of the year + claims intimated during the year) x 100, from IRDAI Handbook 2024-25 Table 53 (Status of Claims of General and Health Insurers). This is the same formula IRDAI applies to the whole health market in Annual Report 2024-25 Table I.29 (326.01 / 372.58 lakh claims = 87.50%), although that table is a separate dataset that excludes PA and travel. Claims still pending at year end count against the ratio. Given ONLY for standalone health insurers, whose Table 53 row covers their whole book (Table 53 does not state its scope; for a standalone health insurer that book is health and may include personal accident and travel). IRDAI does not publish an insurer-wise, health-only claim count for multi-line general insurers (Table 53 mixes motor, fire, crop and every other line), so csr is null for every general insurer by design.
definitions.icr: Incurred claims ratio for health insurance EXCLUDING personal accident and travel, FY 2024-25 = net claims incurred / net earned premium x 100, all health segments combined (government schemes, group, family floater, individual). Taken as published in IRDAI Handbook 2024-25 Table 62, 'Total' column, shown as a percentage to 2 decimals. Available for general insurers and standalone health insurers alike. Note: IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25 Statement 10 shows a different 'Health' ICR that INCLUDES personal accident, so it will not match.
definitions.grievances_per_10k: Grievances per 10,000 policies, FY 2024-25 = Table 56 grievances 'reported during the year' (IRDAI footnote: including opening balance; all lines of business) / Table 58 total health policies (excluding PA and travel) x 10,000. Given ONLY for standalone health insurers, whose grievances come almost entirely from their health book. The bases are close but not identical: Table 56 grievances include any personal accident and travel business, while Table 58 policies exclude it. For general insurers it is null by design: Table 56 counts grievances across all lines (motor, fire, etc.) and IRDAI publishes no insurer-wise all-lines policy count (Handbook Statement 43 is sector totals only), so any per-10k figure would mix bases.
definitions.grievances_raw: Grievances reported during FY 2024-25 as published in IRDAI Handbook 2024-25 Table 56 (Status of Grievances with General and Health Insurers). IRDAI footnote: the figure INCLUDES the opening balance. All lines of business, not health only. Stored for reference, not for display.
definitions.page: All values come from the Handbook's XLSX tables, which have no page numbers, so page is null; locate a value by file + sheet + row (Excel row number). source_url is IRDAI's direct download of the Handbook 2024-25 zip from https://irdai.gov.in/handbook-of-indian-insurance.
definitions.fy: Financial year April 2024 to March 2025, the latest FY for which IRDAI has published insurer-wise data (Handbook 2024-25, released February 2026).
definitions.names: name is the insurer's name as IRDAI lists it for FY 2024-25. aliases are for matching free-text insurer names (compare page); they include later trade names only where this repo documents the change (IndusInd General is the former Reliance General per its Health Infinity wording, UIN RELHLIP23120V042223; Bajaj General per the Bajaj Health Guard page). Match aliases exactly (case-insensitive, whole name), never by prefix or fuzzy match: several general insurers share a brand with a life insurer (Acko Life, Go Digit Life, Future Generali Life, Kotak Mahindra Life, Tata AIA Life), and those must not match.
definitions.null_reason: Per-insurer null_reason explains, metric by metric, why a value is null.
